name: Straight punch
notes: Fast check; high guard blocks; crouch evades. Hit advantage +2; block advantage -4 on first active tick.

name: Body punch
notes: Both guards block; whiff punishable. No automatic counter selection.

name: Heavy cross
notes: Long commitment; no cancellation on whiff.

name: Low kick
notes: Low guard required; standing guard loses to low.

name: Overhead strike
notes: Standing guard required; visibly distinct wind-up.

name: Rising strike
notes: Airborne hit triggers knockdown; no universal invulnerability.

name: Air kick
notes: One per jump; recovery runs in air; landing adds max(remaining,6) recovery ticks.

name: Conference throw
notes: Requires grounded target within 0.65m; held grab-break window 12 ticks; no injury close-up.

name: Break throw
notes: Both return to neutral at separated anchors. Available only during a telegraphed capture.

name: Veto parry
notes: Catches mid/high/overhead only; excludes low and throw. Success adds 24-tick attacker stagger and 8-tick defender recovery.

name: Diplomatic shield
notes: Absorbs one non-throw hit during active window; expires after hit. On absorption both recover for 12 ticks; no extra damage.

name: Paperwork burst
notes: Single short-range hit at 1.4m; paper particles are cosmetic; no projectile simulation in V1.

name: Summit adjourned
notes: Short lunge capped at 0.9m; scripted recovery pose; no camera cut until move resolves. V2 content.

name: Forward dash
notes: 0.8m displacement; no invulnerability; canonical root curve.

name: Back dash
notes: 0.75m retreat; no invulnerability; collision and arena bounds still apply.

name: Jump
notes: 32-tick flight; 0.9m peak; lateral travel up to 0.8m from held direction; no double jump.

name: High guard
notes: Active phase loops while held; regenerates stamina at 8/s; blocks high/mid/overhead.

name: Low guard
notes: Active phase loops while held; blocks low/mid; exposes overhead.

name: Advance
notes: Held state; 1.8m/s; ends on release, collision, or higher-priority legal input.

name: Retreat
input: A or D away from opponent
notes: Held state; 1.45m/s; cannot exit arena.

name: Crouch
notes: Active phase loops; high attacks pass above canonical head volume; does not block automatically.

name: Neutral idle
notes: Loop; guaranteed legal fallback when actor is neutral. Never overrides hitstun.
